suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-7 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Treatment-mediated urethral-stricture risk after TURP or HoLEP performed for documented benign prostatic hyperplasia. Require documented benign prostatic hyperplasia, documented transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP) or holmium laser enucleation of the prostate (HoLEP), and a separately established urethral stricture arising after that procedure with compatible chronology. Do not infer urethral stricture from untreated BPH, lower urinary tract symptoms, or bladder-outlet obstruction alone. Preserve prior urethral instrumentation or trauma, infection, lichen sclerosus, prior pelvic surgery or radiation, and other recognized causes of urethral stricture. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
